investigation_notes.Description: An Office 365 login for karl.saare@client.ee succeeded from Mumbai, India with no MFA and a Windows Azure AD user agent. The source IP has a very high security score (100) even though it is a fixed-line ISP, and the user's recent confirmed logins are from Tallinn, Estonia with no prior confirmations for India. Because the country is novel for this user, MFA was not used, and the IP reputation is elevated, this activity is considered High Priority.
